description: Canonical binary serialization of the version 2 objects (docs/CONSENSUS_V2.md section 4): fixed-width little-endian integers, no varints, u32 counts and lengths checked against maximums before reading, strict decoding (trailing bytes are an error). `valid` cases give an object and its exact bytes; `invalid` cases give bytes and the kind of failure. The limits are PROPOSED constants and are listed in `limits`.

invalid.note: an output with a trailing byte
a header with a trailing byte
a transaction with a trailing byte
only one output (at least two are required)
an input count of 2^32-1 (rejected without reading or allocating anything)
a key image one byte short
an input with a trailing byte
a coinbase with too many outputs
more transactions than the block maximum
a block whose transaction count is cut short
a pruned transaction one byte short
a pruned transaction with a trailing byte
a FULL transaction is not a pruned one: its rings and proofs are extra bytes
a pruned block with more transactions than the maximum

name: v2_serialization

valid.note: an input in the prefix is only its key image
largest nonce and timestamp, zero mix
the maximum number of inputs and outputs and the maximum extra
empty rings encode (validation rejects them later)
three inputs, a full ring each
a header, a coinbase and two transactions
the pruned form of the first transaction
the pruned form at the size limits
the pruned form of the block above
